source_behavior.summary: SetCategoriesTab clears the ContentExplorer selection/preview and switches the explorer to the selected site's authoritative WordPress categories.
source_behavior.side_effect: read-only tab selection; no WordPress mutation

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The Laravel Content Explorer exposes Categories only when the server-selected active site and exact tenant/site Taxonomy API contract agree, then hands off to the existing canonical Taxonomy workspace. That workspace defaults to category and performs the real taxonomy=category read; no duplicate taxonomy state or fake tab success is introduced.

authorization.security_result: The control grants no authority and is absent unless the existing Taxonomy route capability and exact server-issued Taxonomy endpoint validate.

runtime_semantics.authoritative_external_state: Existing Taxonomy workspace reads persisted WordPress taxonomy state through the tenant/site-scoped Taxonomy API with taxonomy=category.

coverage: exact operation marker and Categories label
tenant-qualified canonical Taxonomy destination with authoritative site
foreign tenant remains behind server 404 boundary
